summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors approved shareholder remuneration totaling R$2.03 per common and special preferred share, comprising interest on equity (R$1.57) and dividends (R$0.46). Record date for B3 shares is August 11, 2026; ex-dividend August 12, and payment September 2, 2026. ADR holders have record date August 13, ex-dividend August 13, and payment September 10, 2026. The distribution reflects minimum remuneration under Vale's policy, based on June 30, 2026 balance sheet. Per-share amount may vary due to ongoing buyback program. This is routine dividend/interest on equity disclosure, not a special situation.
